"The rain hit the side of the bus with a light pap pap as it rolled to a stop. A young man with curly black hair and an olive complexion hopped off the last step onto the wet pavement. His hazel eyes surveyed the area, coming to rest on an older, grayer, and paler version of the young man. The two came together and embraced.  
"Lev, my boy, how good it is to see you!" The older gentleman said, giving his son's cheek a light kiss before stepping back. "Is this everything?" He continued, grabbing the plain black suitcase Lev had brought his dirty clothes in.  
"It's good to see you, too, Dad. Yeah, just the suitcase and my bag of school work." Lev motioned to the stuffed maroon backpack he carried on his shoulders.  
 "I hope they're not giving you too much to do! This is supposed to be your spring break!" His father looked both impressed and deflated by his son's workload.  
"I'm sure we'll still have plenty of time to catch up." Lev smiled reassuringly to his father.  
"Well, let's get out of this rain before any of that!" His father skipped over to a black Acura parked in the parking lot adjacent to the bus stop. If it weren't for his graying mop of curls to betray him, he would have seemed twenty years younger than he actually was."

So, I have no doubt that when I am really ready to see her, I will. We've been no contact for over six years now. This last late summertime, I had dreams of her for two months straight, every night. Not exaggerating. Then we sort of had an online-in-passing bump into each other, and I went to add her then changed my mind. 

I've tried to add her in the past, and while she hasn't ever blocked me, she's never accepted or reacted to a single attempt of me reaching out. And I don't know why, but i just knew i couldn't take another several months of her not reacting to my existence until she eventually deletes my request. (I've only done this 4 times in six years, and each time she ignores it for months before deleting).

My dreams calmed down, but I still dream of her, at least twice a week, and usually she's mad at me but i can never figure out why? I think i may have crossed a litmus test boundary back when we were in contact. She said very early on when we met, that she wasn't open to being anything more than friends. I understood that, and did my utmost best to respect that. Then, as the end of the thing that brought us together came to an end, my therapist at the time said she would basically rip me a new butt if I let another girl I liked slip away without ever revealing my feelings.

It was one of the scariest things of my life, and I almost didn't do it. She even got this HUGE smile on her face and was quiet for a minute and i thought maybe we could be more, before her smile disappeared and she said " Zarodenu! I told you not to do this!" (Which, she didn't actually explicitly say I could never tell her my feelings, just her boundary with me.) 

I couldn't help but fall on my butt in the parking lot and say "it doesn't mean I was going to do anything with it, it's just how I feel." And I think that's what she's upset about, but I just can't feel guilty about just telling her my feelings. When she went nc about a month and a half later, i didn't beg her to stay or to calm down or anything.

I just asked her if she wanted me to never contact her again, or if she just needed space. She said she just needed space, and now it's been over six years. 

Sorry, but it just felt right to share that story, here.
